source: Original wire fields and UI messages in clan_disband_ida.json; server rules below are project policy.
schedule: Configured next-maintenance Unix timestamp, future and before 2100. No inferred calendar/default.
authority: Trusted enabled current master101, ordinary clan not99, same available plaza epoch at commit.
cancel: Only while stored deadline is in the future, independent of configured next maintenance.
duplicate: Repeated same state refuses; does not extend deadlines.
maintenance: Explicit offline --clan-maintenance command, no listeners. Database-scoped lock excludes running clan service and another maintenance command; all due ordinary clans deleted atomically with durable per-character notices. Limit 10000 clans per batch fails without writes.
recovery: Canonical absent profile plus one -40 notification per clan connection; notices remain for reconnect until next membership/creation transaction clears them.
retention: Creation receipts, accounts, characters, inventory preserved; only due clan and memberships deleted.
publication: S1030(1,action),S1031(1,action),freshS1016 for requester; S1031 for other accepted members; pending applicants receive freshS1016 only.
